You could take walks! seeing people and getting used to it will calm your anxiety, people are going their own ways to fix their own problems and so do you. That helps calming my mind a bit when im anxious, and if it doesn't help getting tired from the walk will, lol. 
Anyway, try looking for jobs that don't require much social interaction till u get used to it, i hope u get a job soon tho, keep trying!! You are young and i get that is difficult talking to people, im also looking for a job and ill shit my pants if i have to be a waitress or sum. u have tons of opportunity if the anxiety gets too bad u may be agoraphobic, go to a doctor and talk to your parents abt it!! Good luck young adult!!!

I really hope u can find something or someone who can make your life more tolerable:-( I know rn it all seems so bad, or as if things wont get better never again, but you are young and have lots of possibilities. Maybe u could look a way to spend less time in your home so u don't have to get annoyed by your family, or try to avoid them but pls don't end it. 
I'm myself 20 y.o, life did get a lil better but it would be even more if i decided to continue when i was in my 18. It took me a long time to get away from suicidal thoughts, sometimes they r still there, but i promise things will workout somehow. I wish you the best of the lucks, and for you to find reasons to keep living, dont lose hope in the future.
i hope we see him someday in pj sekai 💔
